# The Fireglass Forge of Gor Burad (4039). Generated by "Claude files/tools/fireglass_forge_2026-11-12/gen.py".
# Country scope unless said.

# any scope: the level stays between nothing and the capacity; the fill (0 to 100) and the number of added cisterns are worked out
# for the gauge of the page. DA_Magma_Level_spend calls it too (common/scripted_effects/DA_Special_resources_effects.txt).
DA_FG_refresh_gauge = {
	4039 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_MAX value = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level which = DA_Magma_level_MAX } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level which = DA_Magma_level_MAX }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_FG_fill which = DA_Magma_level }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_FG_fill value = 100 }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_FG_fill which = DA_Magma_level_MAX }
			set_variable = { which = DA_FG_cisterns which = DA_Magma_level_MAX }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_FG_cisterns value = 100 }
			divide_variable = { which = DA_FG_cisterns value = 40 }
		}
	}
}

# what the mountain sends in a month: by tier, by the sluices, and more with the fire led through the giant
DA_FG_set_flow = {
	4039 = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_restored_MF }
			set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 3 } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 8 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 2 } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 6 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_repaired = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle }
			4039 = { multiply_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 0.5 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full }
			4039 = { multiply_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 1.5 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_FG_giant_fed } }
			4039 = { change_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser value = 4 } }
		}
	}
}

# the sluice setting as a province modifier of the hold
DA_FG_sync_hold = {
	4039 = { remove_province_modifier = DA_FG_sluice_full_hold remove_province_modifier = DA_FG_sluice_trickle_hold }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_repaired = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full }
			4039 = { add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FG_sluice_full_hold duration = -1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle }
			4039 = { add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FG_sluice_trickle_hold duration = -1 } }
		}
	}
}

# the heat-wards of tier II: until then every regulated vein we own devastates its province a little
DA_FG_sync_wards = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_at_tier_2 = yes any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_FG_vein_unwarded } }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_FG_vein_unwarded }
			remove_province_modifier = DA_FG_vein_unwarded
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_FG_at_tier_2 = yes } any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_regulated_magma_vein NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_FG_vein_unwarded } } }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_regulated_magma_vein NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_FG_vein_unwarded } }
			add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FG_vein_unwarded duration = -1 }
		}
	}
}

# the two counts the page shows
DA_FG_count_veins = {
	4039 = { set_variable = { which = DA_FG_veins value = 0 } set_variable = { which = DA_FG_wild value = 0 } }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_regulated_magma_vein }
		4039 = { change_variable = { which = DA_FG_veins value = 1 } }
	}
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_unregulated_magma_vein }
		4039 = { change_variable = { which = DA_FG_wild value = 1 } }
	}
}

# everything the page and the hold show, worked out again: after a repair, a tier, a ruling
DA_FG_sync = {
	DA_FG_set_flow = yes
	DA_FG_refresh_gauge = yes
	DA_FG_sync_hold = yes
	DA_FG_sync_wards = yes
	DA_FG_count_veins = yes
}

DA_FG_set_sluice_trickle = {
	set_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle
	clr_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FG_sluice_changed duration = 365 }
	DA_FG_set_flow = yes
	DA_FG_sync_hold = yes
}

DA_FG_set_sluice_flowing = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle
	clr_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FG_sluice_changed duration = 365 }
	DA_FG_set_flow = yes
	DA_FG_sync_hold = yes
}

DA_FG_set_sluice_full = {
	set_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full
	clr_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FG_sluice_changed duration = 365 }
	DA_FG_set_flow = yes
	DA_FG_sync_hold = yes
}

# an event eased the sluices by one step: no wait, the player did not choose it from the page
DA_FG_ease_sluices = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full }
		clr_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle
	}
	DA_FG_set_flow = yes
	DA_FG_sync_hold = yes
}

# province scope: a regulated vein here (a wild one is walled in)
DA_FG_form_vein = {
	remove_province_modifier = DA_unregulated_magma_vein
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_regulated_magma_vein duration = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { NOT = { DA_FG_at_tier_2 = yes } } }
		add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FG_vein_unwarded duration = -1 }
	}
}

# every month, for the owner of Gor Burad once the forge has been found
DA_FG_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_old_save_leftovers = yes }
		DA_FG_convert_old_save = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_active = yes }
		DA_FG_set_flow = yes
		4039 = { change_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level which = DA_Magma_level_Increaser } }
		DA_FG_refresh_gauge = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_FG_repaired = yes } }    # the broken canals: the plan comes nearer
			if = {
				limit = { 4039 = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_restorable_MF } } }
				4039 = { subtract_variable = { which = DA_FG_plan_months value = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { 4039 = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_FG_plan_months value = 1 } } } }
					country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { 4039 = { NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_FG_broken_canals } } }
				4039 = { add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FG_broken_canals duration = -1 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { DA_FG_hold_out_of_step = yes }
				DA_FG_sync_hold = yes
			}
			DA_FG_sync_wards = yes
			DA_FG_count_veins = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					DA_FG_at_tier_3 = yes
					4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_Gor_Burad_exp3 NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_FG_giant_fed } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_FG_giant_sealed } }
					OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_ruling_asked } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_FG_ruling_asked days = 60 } }    # asked once; again if the event could not fire
				}
				clr_country_flag = DA_FG_ruling_asked
				set_country_flag = DA_FG_ruling_asked    # set anew, so that its date is today's
				country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.9 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { DA_FG_at_tier_3 = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_proposal_sent } }
				set_country_flag = DA_FG_proposal_sent
				country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.22 days = 60 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					had_country_flag = { flag = DA_FG_wall_done days = 2920 }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_vale_done }
					owns = 672
					owns = 673
					owns = 674
					owns = 675
					owns = 676
					owns = 677
					owns = 678
				}
				country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.20 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# twice a year while the canals are broken: the fuller the cisterns, the likelier a tremor
DA_FG_tremor_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_active = yes NOT = { DA_FG_repaired = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { 4039 = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level value = 100 } } }
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 4039 = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level value = 80 } } }
			random_list = {
				75 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.4 } }
				25 = { }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 4039 = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level value = 60 } } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.4 } }
				50 = { }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 4039 = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level value = 40 } } }
			random_list = {
				25 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.4 } }
				75 = { }
			}
		}
	}
}

# every year: a tremor check; with the canals mended, what full cisterns and a Full Bore risk; the giant's rage
DA_FG_yearly = {
	DA_FG_tremor_check = yes
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FG_active = yes DA_FG_repaired = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_trickle } }
			if = {
				limit = { DA_FG_cisterns_full = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full }
					random_list = {
						40 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.30 } }
						60 = { }
					}
				}
				else = {
					random_list = {
						20 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.30 } }
						80 = { }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_sluice_full }
				random_list = {
					10 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.31 } }
					90 = { }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_FG_giant_fed } }
			random_list = {
				10 = { country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.40 } }
				90 = { }
			}
		}
	}
}

# a save from before the Fireglass Forge: the monument is raised if it was not, the plan is given a date, the abilities that
# waited for an event are simply there (they follow the tier now), and the wall keeps what it had. Runs once from DA_FG_monthly.
DA_FG_convert_old_save = {
	4039 = {
		set_province_flag = DA_FG_set_up
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge } } }
			add_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge instant = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_MAX value = 100 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_Magma_level_MAX value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_restored_MF } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_restorable_MF } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_FG_plan_months value = 12 }
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_Wonder_Magma_Forge_in_use
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_MF_can_create_Basalt_Wall }
		set_country_flag = DA_FG_proposal_sent
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 672 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Verkal_Jorkad tier = 3 } } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FG_wall_done } }
		set_country_flag = DA_FG_wall_done
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 673 = { has_province_modifier = DA_Prosperity_behind_the_wall } }
		set_country_flag = DA_FG_vale_done
	}
	DA_FG_sync = yes
}
